title: StockTok ETF Doubles the S&P 500 - Update on What to Buy, Hold & Sell
description: The portfolio is breaking out to new highs. Here is a review of all 10 holdings and the adjustments. Also an update on Silver and the Russell 2000
body_html:
While much of the market remains stuck in a frustrating cycle of rallies and selloffs, the StockTok ETF seems to have not gotten the memo. The portfolio reached another all-time high, more than doubling the S&P 500. Several of the holdings still have room to run, while a few new opportunities are emerging. Today, we are reviewing what is performing, what needs to be changed and what stocks we should add to.

About every 6 months, I update/build a new “ETF” as this is designed for the longer term investors with busy schedules, or for those that do now want to look at charts everyday. Back on July 28th we built the next ETF, and this also is beating the S&P 500. It started off a little choppy, which is normal considering the broader market. But considering this is just now breaking out as well, we can see that trend is working well for us.

See the StockTok ETF 2.0 (click here)

Here is the of all 10 stocks in the StockTok ETF 2.0. Valero for example, has gained over 28% and it is now time to lock in those profits. Also below is the updated Russell 2000, and Silver, entry criteria levels.

StockTok ETF 2.0 Quick Summary:

  • Valero Energy Corporation, - Trim or cut

  • Cheesecake Factory, - Hold

  • HNI Corporation, - Hold

  • PC Connection, - Hold

  • United Bankshares, - Hold/Buy

  • Textron Inc., - Hold/Buy

  • Prudential, - Hold

  • Simon Property Group, - Hold

  • Franklin Electric, - Hold

  • M&T Bank Corporation, - Hold/Buy

I’m just going to cover the stocks that do NOT have “Hold” next to them, as in my opinion and analysis, there is nothing to change or do. These are trending fine (at least for now) on the macro timeframes. Fortunately, most of them look fantastic still.

Valero, - Trim or Cut

Energy has gotten entirely too much attention from retail investors. This is often a warning sign. I was very interested back in January 2026 and July 202. But fast forward to today, and everyone on social media thinks they are early to fuel companies. Maybe they are…. but I find it unlikely. Also, the stock price is showing reactivity to selling days, such as on the 27th of October, with above average selling volume, the stock dropped -9%. Compare that to the above average buying volume on the 30th, and the stock only rose 3%. This indicates that the bears are most likely gaining control of momentum and direction. This stock is up 27% since the ETF came out… so cashing out some gains wouldn’t be a bad idea.

This was the only stock, after review, that I said in my head: “looks weak”

Now, some stocks that are showing promising signs of further breakouts:

United Bankshares, - Hold/Buy

You all know that I target stocks that are just recently tapping their 52-day highs, or 52-week highs… as the only way you can make NEW all time highs, is by doing the aforementioned. While most of the stock market has been struggling the last few weeks, United Bankshares has just been pushing up, and yesterday, tapped it’s 52-day highs. This is no surprise as the monthly chart has formed a massive volatility contraction pattern, and I expect significantly higher prices for this regional bank. The big banks have been struggling, but the smaller regional ones have been trending exceptionally well.

Textron Inc., - Hold/Buy

Textron was a little fussy since joining this ETF. However, their latest earnings pump has caught my attention. Recall, when we reviewed the best performing stocks from the 2025 StockTok screener, the single biggest determination of a high performance stock, was it gapping up significantly. On the 29th of October, Textron gapped up 11%, surprising analysts with a ~23% beat for earnings. Also, the price action just got back over the 200 day moving average. Though the daily chart was a little scary at first, the monthly chart remains well intact, and this near term reversal is promising.

M&T Bank Corporation, - Hold/Buy

Sectors tend to run together. It is no surprise that if United Bankshares is pointing upwards, so is M&T Bank. The macro volatility contraction pattern remains well intact; and price action was tapping the 200 day moving average, but did not want to clearly break it. It just recently got back over that line. Earnings is behind this company, and we are largely only seeing strength thus far.

Now for updates to Silver and the Russell 2000.

Silver,

I had someone get fussy at me on TikTok (go figure lol), about Silver. They thought that silver was going to be at bajillion dollars by now. I clearly stated in several videos, that Silver is a LONG TERM play. I expect silver to do well in the months ahead. That said, in the short term, it has been trending down on the daily time frame. When a stock is going down locally, I do not buy. Buying descending assets is fighting trend, and most often loses.

I still think silver is going to do exceptionally well in the coming months, but I will not enter until some strength is shown locally. No point in holding an asset that is just going to cause me grief over the next couple of days or weeks.

Zooming into the 4-hour chart, it has consistently trended down. I would not consider a position until at least $56 is achieved (getting above the 200 4-hr moving average, signaling reversal in local trend). And I would not start getting aggressive with the position until the 52 4-hr high is being tested again, which is all the way up at $64.

Again, I think these targets will happen… but let price action prove itself that it is reversing. No point in wriggling in pain waiting. If you are looking for something to replace Valero with, from the ETF, I think Silver will be a fine replacement, when and if the price action comes back upwards.

Russell 2000,

The Russell 2000 has also been fussy. This has largely been driven from chaotic news events. Fortunately, we are seeing some reversals. Unlike silver, the Russell has in fact gotten back over the 200 4-hr moving average. Now , which tracks the Russell, has not yet gotten over, but a decent small, starter position would be around $286 or higher. I will get more aggressive when and if price re-achieves $304.

If you have questions about any of these updates, just swing by the main chat.

Thanks for stopping by!
